note: Small Hiawatha NF campground on a bluff overlooking the Indian River, 19.8 mi N of Manistique on M-94 (14.2 mi S of Shingleton); a short trail leads down to the river. Large, wooded, private sites. Near the halfway point of the Indian River Canoe Trail, a convenient overnight stop for canoeists. --Claude
